MathUtils.luau.description: Holds utilty MathUtils functions not available on Roblox's MathUtils library. Public entry points include `MathUtils.map`, `MathUtils.mapNonNegative`, `MathUtils.jitter`, `MathUtils.addCommas`, `MathUtils.nextOrder`, `MathUtils.isNaN`, `MathUtils.isFinite`, `MathUtils.lerp`.
